threads.title: Choose Your Return Point
threads.event: You arrived at the starting world as a spectator.
threads.cause: Spectator is your preview. The first return point you choose is the one that sticks - later beds will not move it.
threads.action: Scout the area, settle on a return point you would want to wake up in, then finalize your class.

threads.title: Make a First Hand Axe
threads.event: You have had a moment to get your bearings.
threads.cause: A primitive hand axe starts your wood supply. Hanging roots can become its canvas binding without a knife; a primitive knife opens the alternative route from grass to straw to canvas.
threads.action: Compare the rock, flint, and bone axes and knives below in EMI. Choose a route, make an axe, then gather wood for the Tinkers stations.

threads.title: Start With Tinkers Tools
threads.event: You made a primitive hand axe.
threads.cause: The axe starts the wood supply. A Part Builder and a Tinker Station turn that wood into your first durable mining tool.
threads.action: Make those two stations, build tool parts, and assemble a pickaxe.

threads.title: Make a Backpack
threads.event: You made a crafting table.
threads.cause: The table gives you room to craft a backpack. Portable storage keeps a trip from ending at your first full inventory.
threads.action: Gather straw by cutting grass with a primitive knife, then inspect the backpack below in EMI.

threads.title: An Approaching Cave Threat Was Announced
threads.event: A cave encounter announced it was coming for you.
threads.cause: Rumbles, distant sounds, and falling debris are the warning, and they arrive from the direction of the approach.
threads.action: Face the sound, find your exit, and get ready before it arrives.

threads.title: You Approached Hazardous Exposed Hotstone
threads.event: You approached exposed Hotstone.
threads.cause: Hotstone burns underfoot. From a distance it passes for ordinary ground, which is how people walk onto it.
threads.action: Mark a path around it before you get closer.

threads.title: Cultivars Can Grow Abroad
threads.event: Your imported cultivar produced a harvest in the Overworld.
threads.cause: Bumblezone is where these food plants come from, but a seed you carry home grows under Overworld conditions like anything else.
threads.action: Keep seeds for replanting and check what the plant needs to grow.

threads.title: Bring Planting Stock Home
threads.event: You harvested a wild crop without planting stock.
threads.cause: Wild vegetables and rice are finite food, not planting stock. Bumblezone cultivars supply the seeds for a renewable farm.
threads.action: Bring planting stock back from Bumblezone and start a farm at home.

threads.title: Fruit Fuels a Sprint
threads.event: You ate your first fruit.
threads.cause: Fruit builds orchard nutrition: softened falls at 20%, better movement, and a sprinting jump burst at 80%.
threads.action: Pack fruit when a long journey is coming.

threads.title: Vegetables Buffer Exposure
threads.event: You ate your first vegetable.
threads.cause: Vegetables build garden nutrition: protection from temperature drift at 20% and from knockback at 40%.
threads.action: Keep vegetables in your travel food mix.

threads.title: Dry Food for the Journey
threads.event: You picked up food that can be dried.
threads.cause: Drying prepares food for travel before spoilage or cold can ruin it on the way.
threads.action: Check its drying recipe in EMI and put a reserve away.

threads.title: Frozen Food Cannot Be Eaten
threads.event: The food you tried to eat was frozen.
threads.cause: Frozen food has to thaw first, and its temperature sticks with it - in storage and when matching stacks merge.
threads.action: Warm it up and check the tooltip before trying again.

threads.title: Sweetness Drained Your Nutrition
threads.event: Sweetness drained one of your food groups below 20%.
threads.cause: Sugar multiplies your unlocked food benefits while hunger and nutrition drain faster. Below 20% a group loses its first ability, and that is the crash.
threads.action: Eat food for the depleted group before you add more sweetness.

threads.title: Nutrition Strengthened That Blow
threads.event: Your prepared attack triggered Heavy Blow.
threads.cause: Flesh nutrition unlocks the heavy charged strike at 40%. It needs four seconds since your last attack, then a 12-second recovery.
threads.action: Keep protein nutrition up, and do not count on two heavy blows in a row.

threads.title: Sustained Work Built a Stronger Rhythm
threads.event: Your mining sequence reached full Work Rhythm.
threads.cause: Granary nutrition builds a mining rhythm out of successive correct-tool breaks. At 60% the rhythm survives a five-second pause.
threads.action: Take suitable tools and provisions when you plan a long mining session.

threads.title: Nutrition Activated Your Deep Reserve
threads.event: Your nutritional reserve activated during resource depletion.
threads.cause: High fat nutrition covers you briefly when hunger, thirst, or stamina hits bottom. It is a loan, not a fix.
threads.action: Restore what ran out and get somewhere safe to recover.

threads.title: Nutrition Cleansed an Effect
threads.event: Your nutrition removed a harmful status effect.
threads.cause: High dairy nutrition can cleanse a finite harmful effect. It does nothing for Death's Door injuries.
threads.action: Check what is left on you, and use the Body screen for injuries that need medicine.

threads.title: Ore Chunks Need Separation
threads.event: You extracted your first geological ore chunk.
threads.cause: A chunk is raw deposit material. A String Mesh pulls the useful ore out of it before the bigger machines are worth building.
threads.action: Build a String Mesh and process the chunk.

threads.title: Maintain a Tinkers Tool
threads.event: Your assembled Tinkers tool is running low.
threads.cause: A worn Tinkers tool is repaired, not replaced - it keeps its parts and its history.
threads.action: Inspect its repair material and restore it before the next expedition.

threads.title: Alloy in the Smeltery
threads.event: You used a Melter or Smeltery.
threads.cause: Tinkers molten metals combine into alloys here. Create mixing handles a different set of recipes.
threads.action: Check which alloy is available and pour a useful casting.

threads.title: Molten Ingredients Became an Alloy
threads.event: Your smeltery created an alloy from component fluids.
threads.cause: Alloying consumes compatible fluids in specific proportions at a suitable temperature. Fluids sitting in a tank have not reacted yet.
threads.action: Check the alloy recipe and cast the result into the form you need.

threads.title: A Lit Furnace Produces Pollution
threads.event: You opened a furnace that will pollute the air while it burns.
threads.cause: A burning furnace releases pollution. A chimney routes the exhaust away; it does not make the emission disappear.
threads.action: Place and route a chimney before you run a larger furnace bank.

threads.title: Escaped Gas Became Pollution
threads.event: Gas from your material escaped into the atmosphere.
threads.cause: Uncontained gas becomes native world pollution once it is out. Airtight storage keeps it sealed as long as the sealed state lasts.
threads.action: Contain gas before storing or moving it, and use native pollution controls for what is already released.

threads.title: Disturbing Ore Activated Its Emissions
threads.event: Your disturbance activated a radioactive material form.
threads.cause: Natural hosted radioactive ore can sit inert until you disturb it. Mined, carried, contained, and replaced forms keep emitting radiation and heat.
threads.action: Check the material's emission information and plan handling before you move more.

threads.title: Radioactive Material Transferred Heat
threads.event: Your thermal system accepted heat from radioactive material.
threads.cause: Radioactive material releases heat into Heat Sync. That is heat transfer; the radiation itself does not go away.
threads.action: Provide a controlled thermal path and manage emissions separately.

threads.title: Begin with a Millstone or Press
threads.event: You inspected a Millstone or Mechanical Press recipe.
threads.cause: These early Create machines turn hand work into repeatable processing once rotational power reaches them.
threads.action: Hover over either machine below and use EMI to inspect its recipe, then build one and give it rotation.

threads.title: Plan Sustained Rotation
threads.event: You placed your first Millstone or Mechanical Press.
threads.cause: A Hand Crank runs it for now. Sustained water or wind power opens up after Nether access.
threads.action: Crank the first operation, then plan a continuous drive for later.

threads.title: Manual Rotation Powered a Machine
threads.event: You ran your first Create machine by hand.
threads.cause: The Hand Crank is this pack's first rotational source - before the Nether, this is where power comes from.
threads.action: Use the crank for the next process EMI or Ponder shows you.

threads.title: Transmission Overloaded the Network
threads.event: Transmission overhead pushed your network past its capacity.
threads.cause: Shafts, gears, gearboxes, and belts all spend stress. A network sized for its machines alone can still overload once transmission is counted.
threads.action: Shorten or simplify the transmission, slow it where that helps, or add capacity.

threads.title: Coolant Exchange Restored Safety
threads.event: Coolant exchange brought your exchanger's heat buffer back into its safe range.
threads.cause: A working coolant exchanger converts fluid and moves heat out of its buffer. Cooling the exchanger does not prove the machines attached to it are safe.
threads.action: Keep coolant available and check each connected machine's temperature.

threads.title: Electricity Powered a Consumer
threads.event: You completed your first powered electrical operation.
threads.cause: A useful electrical system needs generation, transmission, and something consuming the power. A charged terminal alone is not delivery.
threads.action: When output stops, check the consumer and the network feeding it.

threads.title: A Precision Assembly Sequence Finished
threads.event: You completed a precision assembly.
threads.cause: Sequenced assembly runs ordered operations over an intermediate, sometimes repeatedly. The finished mechanism only exists at the final result.
threads.action: Follow EMI's sequence and repeat count when you automate the next batch.

threads.title: Your Anchored Machine Worked While You Were Away
threads.event: An anchored operation continued while you were out of range.
threads.cause: A supplied chunk anchor keeps its area running with no player nearby. Its ticket is what held this operation open.
threads.action: Keep the anchor supplied and check which area it actually holds.

threads.title: Meteor Quartz Starts Logistics
threads.event: You inspected the certus-powered pipe recipe.
threads.cause: Meteor Certus Quartz makes scalable pipes possible without an operating ME network.
threads.action: Find an AE2 meteor and use one certus crystal to craft the first eight pipes.

threads.title: Kills Release Trading Spirits
threads.event: You made first contact with a spirit trader.
threads.cause: Some traders take spirits as currency, and the reserve you spend there is the reserve Malum crafting no longer has.
threads.action: Compare the offers before you decide what to keep for crafting.

threads.title: Your Authored Spell Took Effect
threads.event: You cast your first authored spell.
threads.cause: Spell components decide how the spell travels and what it does on arrival. A design that saves cleanly can still fail in the field.
threads.action: Inspect the components and test the next change on a suitable target.

threads.title: Your Relic Developed Through Use
threads.event: A relic you used crossed a development boundary.
threads.cause: Relics gain experience through their own working abilities. Growth sticks to the physical relic - a copy with the same name is a different item.
threads.action: Inspect its updated abilities and keep using it where they apply.

threads.title: Ruinous Flux Resolved Permanently
threads.event: Your confirmed Ruinous Flux application resolved.
threads.cause: Ruinous Flux either mutates a part permanently or destroys it. A surviving mutation locks that part against any further mutation.
threads.action: Look at what actually happened before deciding how to use the surviving part.

threads.title: Find a Dimensional Font
threads.event: Your first Tinkers tool is assembled.
threads.cause: Dimensional Fonts are the way out of the Overworld, and traders sell maps that lead to them.
threads.action: Ask traders about Font maps and prepare for your first departure.

threads.title: Race the Font’s Clock
threads.event: You approached a Dimensional Font.
threads.cause: A Font journey spends charge and runs against a return window. Both are easier to plan for before you enter.
threads.action: Check the available charge, pack essentials, and plan your return.

threads.title: A Dimensional Font Transported You
threads.event: A Font transported you into its journey.
threads.cause: The radial Dimensional Font carries you between worlds and holds the route home while the run lasts.
threads.action: Orient yourself at the destination and keep the return window in mind.

threads.title: Vanilla Boats Break Into Parts
threads.event: You boarded a vanilla boat.
threads.cause: Boats here have limited durability, and a broken one gives some of its construction material back.
threads.action: Keep replacement material handy before a long crossing.

threads.title: Your Build Became a Moving Vessel
threads.event: You moved aboard your first vessel.
threads.cause: A physical ship carries its assembled structure through the world. Standing on a floating structure proves nothing about transport.
threads.action: Inspect the vessel's controls and plan where to stop or land.

threads.title: Rats in the Overworld
threads.event: You engaged a native Rats creature in its new Overworld habitat.
threads.cause: Rat materials and creatures occur on coasts, in warm oceans, and below ground without a Ratlantis expedition.
threads.action: Explore beaches and jungle fringes, or descend into lush and dripstone caves for rare ores.

threads.title: Your Rocket Reached Orbit
threads.event: Your tracked rocket journey arrived in Earth orbit.
threads.cause: Reaching orbit is a journey result, not a readiness estimate. It takes an assembled rocket with the propulsion and destination to match.
threads.action: Secure air and a return route, then see what is nearby.

threads.title: Speed Increased Fuel Consumption
threads.event: Your moving train burned fuel above its ordinary-speed baseline.
threads.cause: Fuel use climbs with speed along a scaling curve, so the fastest travel can cost disproportionately more.
threads.action: Slow down, or provision fuel for the speed you intend to keep.

threads.title: A Rail Beetle Built Your Route
threads.event: Your Rail Beetle completed its first route.
threads.cause: The Beetle builds through loaded terrain from the rails, supports, and engine work you supplied. The finished railway is what it actually constructed.
threads.action: Inspect the finished route, reload supplies, then pick the next section.

threads.title: The World Changed, the Lineage Remained
threads.event: You entered a verified successor of your existing lineage.
threads.cause: The World Condenser replaces the world while designated lineage records carry on: the archive persists and the successor starts a fresh discovery score. The Condenser currently needs a dedicated server; integrated single-player support is planned.
threads.action: Review the successor conditions and which records carried forward.
